findings.text: The regex `[0-9;]+m` requires at least one digit/semicolon before `m`, so common reset code `\033[m` won't match and will leak unescaped ESC into XML output, corrupting it.
Non-SGR ANSI sequences like cursor moves (`\033[2J`) or line clears that don't end in `m` are not matched, allowing raw ESC characters into XML output.
